summary:
Lunar Survival is an interactive, browser-based educational game that simulates the challenges of keeping a research outpost running near the Moon's south pole. Players take on the role of an outpost commander and must manage six important systems: oxygen, power, food, water, shelter, and thermal control. Throughout a seven-sol mission, they choose operations, respond to random events, and make decisions that affect the survival of their crew.

Our project addresses the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge by helping students understand the difficulties of living and working on the Moon through an engaging, hands-on experience. It teaches systems thinking, resource management, scientific uncertainty, and mission planning. Lunar Survival is important because it makes complex space exploration concepts easier to understand while encouraging creativity, problem-solving, and interest in future space missions.
details:
Lunar Survival is an interactive educational game that simulates the challenges of keeping a research outpost running near the Moon's south pole. Players take the role of an outpost commander and must keep their crew safe during a seven-sol mission. They manage six essential systems: oxygen, power, food, water, shelter, and temperature. Players choose different mission operations, respond to unexpected events, and make decisions that affect the success of the mission.

The project helps students understand the challenges of living on the Moon in an engaging and interactive way. It develops problem-solving, critical thinking, resource management, and decision-making skills while encouraging interest in space exploration. Its intended impact is to make complex space science concepts easier to understand and inspire students to learn more about future lunar missions.

We developed Lunar Survival using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with a web browser and code editor to build and test the game. GitHub Pages was used to publish it so that anyone can access and play it online.

The creative part of our project is turning a serious space exploration challenge into a playable experience where every decision matters. While developing it, we considered the limited resources available on the Moon, the importance of keeping astronauts safe, unexpected mission challenges, and making the game educational, understandable, and enjoyable for students.
